B1.rule: valid earlier/later pair (same AOI, later after earlier, maps exist)

B2.rule: same real-world event_id; calendar proximity is not sufficient

B3.rule: jointly valid transition mask (unknown never inferred)

B4.rule: no target leakage; in-horizon rain is POST-T0 OBSERVATION

B6.rule: transition signal: ≥20 pairs with new-flood or recession, mean turnover ≥0.01, ≥5 events; pixel count alone is not enough

B7.rule: ≥8 independent events represented by pairs (not pair count)
